critical_code_review_comments: alerts.py newsletter_send_now: parameter name `user` shadows via Depends but variable also used inside; when non-admin path targets are [await db.users.find_one({_id: ObjectId(user['id'])})] — if for any reason the DB returns None (deleted user), the loop will attempt u['email'] and 500. Add a None check.

articles.list_articles: comment_count aggregation uses str(_id) match against comments.article_id — correct. But saved set is fetched even for scope!=saved, adding an extra query on every list call. Small optimization: reuse the ids already fetched to filter bookmarks with $in.

user_data.portfolio_history: forward-fill only appends a point when len(last)==len(shares) — meaning for a short range where one symbol has fewer bars, the series can start empty and dates before every symbol has data are skipped. Fine for MVP; consider filling with last-known value or 0 for missing symbols.
market_data.market_overview: CADUSD=X price rounded to 4 decimals is correct; change_percent rounded to 2 dp may show 0.00 for tiny FX moves. Consider 3 dp for FX kind.
articles.py `md.lstrip('markdown')` still present (character-set strip, not prefix). Flagged in iter7; not fixed. Low priority.
alerts.py APP_URL from env — verify APP_PUBLIC_URL is set so newsletter emails contain working article links; empty base_url renders links as '/articles/<id>' which won't open from email clients.
